title: AutoBet
tagline: Decentralized binary betting on FLOW EVM and Kadena Chainweb EVM Testnet — create, join, claim bets.
description: AutoBet is a decentralized betting platform built on the FLOW EVM and Kadena Chainweb EVM Testnet that enables anyone to create, participate in, and resolve custom betting events in a fully transparent and trustless way. Bettors can stake on binary outcomes (Yes/No), while creators earn a 3% fee from the total pool. The platform handles settlement automatically via smart contracts, ensuring instant claims, proportional payouts, and a non-custodial design where funds remain secure on-chain. With a clean, mobile-friendly interface powered by Next.js, TailwindCSS, and RainbowKit, AutoBet makes decentralized betting fast, affordable, and user-friendly.
how_its_made: AutoBet is built using a full-stack Web3 architecture that combines Solidity smart contracts with a modern Next.js frontend. The contracts, written in Solidity 0.8.19 and secured with OpenZeppelin libraries, handle bet creation, participation, resolution, and proportional payout distribution in a non-custodial way. On the frontend, Next.js powers routing and server-side rendering, TailwindCSS ensures responsive styling, and Framer Motion adds smooth animations. Wallet connectivity is enabled through RainbowKit, while wagmi manages blockchain interactions, contract reads/writes, and event listening for real-time updates. Deployment and testing were done using Hardhat, with FLOW EVM Testnet providing a fast, low-cost environment for transactions and settlement. This stack ensures security, transparency, and a seamless user experience across devices.
